_readme: Shop demo settings (shop.html / shop.js). mode 'demo' shows data/shop-demo.json and disables checkout. To go live: set mode to 'live', storeDomain to your-store.myshopify.com and storefrontAccessToken to the PUBLIC Storefront API token from Shopify admin > Sales channels > Headless (never an Admin API token or the Headless PRIVATE token). See docs/SHOP.md.
